user.title: Mealie API
user.description: URL of your Mealie instance and an API token (Mealie → Profile → API tokens).

create_recipe.name: Create Mealie recipe
create_recipe.description: Creates a new recipe in Mealie from name, ingredients and steps. Returns slug and URL.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: Mealie API instance (only needed if there are several).

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: One per item or line, e.g. '500 g shrimp'. Replaces all ingredients on update.

instructions.name: Instructions
instructions.description: One step per item or line. Replaces all steps on update.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Tag names; missing tags are created. Replaces all tags on update.

categories.name: Categories
categories.description: Category names; missing categories are created. Replaces all categories on update.

update_recipe.name: Update Mealie recipe
update_recipe.description: Updates fields of an existing Mealie recipe. Only given fields change.

create_from_json.name: Create Mealie recipe from JSON/HTML
create_from_json.description: Creates a recipe from schema.org JSON or HTML.

config_entry_id.description: Mealie API instance (only needed if there are several).

data.name: Data
data.description: schema.org Recipe JSON (object or text) or the HTML of a recipe page.

set_recipe_image.name: Set Mealie recipe image
set_recipe_image.description: Sets a recipe image from a URL or file.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: URL of an image Mealie downloads.

image_path.name: Image path
image_path.description: Path to an image file in HA (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).

api_request.description: Arbitrary request to the Mealie REST API (shopping lists, meal plans, tags …). Returns the response.
